facts.fact: Mooch 十二岁时被宣布不育（归因被说成土壤里的铀、水里的农业径流、电线的辐射、诊所的处置或政府的政策），但她此后连生三个完美男孩，十八岁便有了她从不敢梦想的完美家庭。
facts.anchor: Mooch, declared sterile and barren at twelve because of uranium in the soil or agricultural runoff in the water or power-line radiation in the air or medical procedures at the clinic or government policy everywhere, she’d conceived not one, not two, but three perfect boys, and so, by eighteen, had the perfect family she’d never dared dream of.

facts.fact: 三个儿子都以地点命名：老大 Shelby（Trace 把车勉强靠边之处得名）、老二 Brady（前座热恋的惊险中得名），老三本想因一部没看成完的电影叫「Kalispell」，最终因哥哥们没钱加油的又一次车程得名 Conrad。
facts.anchor: The first she named Shelby, because of where Trace had pulled them barely enough off the road, everyone passing them laying on their horns to help them along, the middle was Brady, though that was a close one, with how hot and heavy things had been in the front seat, and the third she thought was going to be “Kalispell” because of that movie they didn’t exactly see there, but then her moon came and, thanks to another drive her brothers didn’t have gas money for, her last son got to be Conrad.

facts.fact: Two Bulls 三十四岁，恰好是 Shelby 如今会是的年纪；Mooch 从没告诉他、也永远不会说，怕搅乱某些事。
facts.anchor: She hadn’t told him, and never would lest it mess certain things up, but at thirty-four he was the exact age Shelby would be, now.

facts.fact: 两年四个月十四天前的 Red Eagle Fire 带走了以善良 Blackfeet 身份出外救火的 Shelby 和 Brady；为此受伤的 Trace（多少）买账了 Plenty Wolf 的说辞。
facts.anchor: But Trace, hurting from the Red Eagle Fire two years, four months, and fourteen days before—from that fire having taken Shelby and Brady away when they, being good Blackfeet, went out to fight it—he… he had bought Plenty Wolf’s spiel, sort of?

facts.fact: Trace 再也没醒来——Mooch 和 Conrad 握着他的手怎么哀求都没用——因此他从没告诉 Conrad 角度与重力、要从小的跳开始；此前他在次子生日的小组会后与 Plenty Wolf 一起复吸，四天后才被 Mooch 找到并亲自抱进医院。
facts.anchor: And it was too late. Trace never woke up again, no matter how hard Mooch and Conrad held his hands and begged him to, and so he never told Conrad about angles and gravity, and how you start small, son, not with the biggest jump.

facts.fact: Mooch 把账算在 Plenty Wolf 头上：坡道是她一钉一板钉起来的，摩托车的油是她一杯一杯（甚至一口一口）加的——她全程清楚自己不会是骑车的那个人。
facts.anchor: Plenty Wolf, though, she was the one who hammered that ramp together nail by nail, board by board. She was the one filling that motorcycle’s gas tank up cup by steady cup, maybe even mouthful by mouthful, knowing the whole while she wouldn’t be the one riding it.

facts.fact: Mooch 咳嗽作掩护，滑出 awl 用尖头抵进灶台上方的小门——她确信那对别人只是遮住粗短烟囱管的装饰假门——把它顶开，取出藏在后面的 Nokia 515。
facts.anchor: She coughs to slide the awl up, palm its ball, run the deadly shaft up under her middle finger and direct the point into the short door above the tiny range hood, that she’s pretty sure is a dummy door for everyone else, just decoration to hide that stubby chimney pipe.

facts.fact: Mooch 播放 Conrad 跳跃的录像（背景歌是 Leech Lake 男孩的「All Right Now」），就在他从坡道末端起跳的瞬间按下通话键、止住了手机震动。
facts.anchor: Right when he launches off the end of that ramp, she touches the call button, stopping the buzzing.
